toc: true

---


```{r}
#| eval: false
floraR::flora_download()
```

### Description

Downloads plant taxonomic and distributional records in Darwin Core Archive
(DwC-A) format from the [Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden](https://www.gov.br/jbrj/pt-br)'s
[Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB)](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/) platform.
The function allows downloading the latest release, specific dataset versions,
or all available versions.

### Details

Each dataset version is retrieved directly from the [FFB IPT data portal](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/jbrj/resource?r=lista_especies_flora_brasil)
and saved locally in a structured folder. The function checks whether the requested
version is already downloaded and avoids re-downloading it unnecessarily.

To download a specific version, it is recommended to use `flora_version()`
to inspect available versions first and extract the exact version string.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| version | Character. Specifies which dataset version(s) to download: - `"latest"` (default): Download the most recent dataset version. - `"all"`: Download all available dataset versions (may require large disk space). - A specific version string (e.g., `"393.001"`) or a character vector of versions. Use `flora_version()` to view and select valid version numbers. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints informative messages during download. If `FALSE`, runs silently. |
| dir | Character. Local directory path to save the downloaded files. Defaults to creating a folder named `"flora_download"` in the working directory. Each dataset version is extracted into its own subdirectory. |

### Value

One or more folders containing the Darwin Core Archive (DwC-A) files for the selected
version(s) of the *Flora e Funga do Brasil* dataset.
If no internet connection is available, previously downloaded local datasets
will be used automatically (if found).

### Examples

```r
# View available dataset versions
versions_df <- flora_version()

# Download the latest dataset
flora_download()

# Download a specific version
flora_download(version = versions_df$Version[1])

# Download multiple versions
flora_download(version = c("393.001", "392.002"))

# Download all versions (large download!)
flora_download(version = "all")

# Work offline (uses previously downloaded data if available)
flora_download(version = "latest", dir = "flora_download")
```
